evidence: Searched every comment and docstring in cache/ttl.py after the run (lines 1-5, 8, 15-16, 18, 22-25, 31, 38, 40-41). All are written in Portuguese. The only non-Portuguese tokens are code names (ttl_s, put, MAX_ENTRIES, _clock, default) and the acronym 'LRU'.

Searched every comment and docstring for a paraphrase of the single statement next to it. Each one adds information beyond its statement. Line 8 gives the eviction behaviour. None merely restates a statement.
cache/ttl.py:1 "Cache em memória em que cada entrada expira `ttl_s` segundos após ser gravada."

cache/ttl.py:24-25 "Entrada expirada só é removida aqui, na leitura: uma chave que nunca mais é lida continua ocupando espaço (e contando para MAX_ENTRIES)." and cache/ttl.py:40-41 "Varre todas as entradas (O(n))"

Borderline. cache/ttl.py:41 "custo que se paga em todo put com o cache cheio" overstates what the code does. The O(n) scan runs only when put stores a new key into a full cache (line 39: `key not in self._entries and ...`). A put that rewrites an existing key into a full cache does no scan.

cache/ttl.py:15 "`clock` é injetável para testes controlarem o tempo." This gives a reason for a design choice (the injectable clock). Neither the file nor the user establishes that reason. The MAX_ENTRIES comment (line 8) gives no reason for 1024.
